strings.intro: Organise original documents, preserve their attribution and rights, and choose the libraries they belong to.
strings.private: Private curator workspace · file and metadata changes are saved to this local catalogue. They do not establish approval for technical advice.
strings.load_error: The workspace could not be loaded. Check the local connection and try again.
strings.library_deleted: Library deleted; its documents are retained.
strings.operation_error: The change could not be saved. Your form is still here so you can try again.
strings.empty_catalogue_help: Create a catalogue version, then add libraries and their documents.
strings.version_help: Start with a letter or number, then use letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens. For example: oasis-library-v1. The identifier is used by export tools.
strings.no_libraries_help: Add a named library such as Farming or Water. Existing originals can belong to more than one library.
strings.library_delete_help: This removes the library and its {count} child folders from this catalogue version. Original documents and their metadata are retained. Membership in other libraries is retained.
strings.confirm_library: Type the library name to confirm
strings.no_documents: No documents in this library yet
strings.no_documents_help: Upload an original document or select All documents to organise existing files.
strings.no_files_help: Upload an original file to begin your catalogue.
strings.file_help: Choose an original document to store locally. The file remains available without internet access.
strings.replacement_help: A replacement keeps the document ID. The original changes everywhere this document is used, including other catalogue versions.
strings.file_required: Choose an original file before uploading.
strings.title: Title
strings.rights_help: Record the licence, permissions and any exceptions for this document. Uploading does not establish permission to publish it.
strings.membership_help: Choose every library or folder for this document in the selected catalogue version. Membership in other versions is preserved.
strings.no_membership_help: This version has no libraries yet. You can upload now and organise the document after creating a library.
strings.metadata_help: Select existing values or add a field and value. Existing metadata IDs are preserved; new values are reusable across the catalogue.
strings.field_help: For example: Creator, Source, Licence or Language.
strings.metadata_error: The metadata value could not be saved. Try again.
strings.no_metadata_types: No metadata fields yet. Add a field to record author, source, licence or language information.
strings.date_help: A recorded review date does not establish approval for technical advice.
strings.active_help: This is the existing catalogue flag. It is not an approval or publishing record.
strings.duplicatable_help: Keep the existing export preference. The document’s rights statement determines permitted uses.
strings.edit_scope: The document’s details, metadata and original file are shared across catalogue versions. Library membership changes apply only to the selected version.
strings.invalid_response: The catalogue returned an invalid response.
strings.incomplete_response: The catalogue returned an incomplete list.
strings.delete_document_help: Delete “{name}” ({file}) and its original file from the whole catalogue. It will be removed from every library and catalogue version. Existing exported copies are separate and are not recalled.
strings.advanced_help: Open the retained tools for export builds, catalogue versions, metadata administration and modules.
strings.advanced_error: Advanced tools could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
